title: Heterogeneous independent scalar channels collapse to one scalar infimum on a fixed cardinal block

envelope.exchangeable_weights: On one fixed K1683 cardinal block, translation covariance gives packet fourth mass L_N/d_N and diagonal whitened score weight T_N/d_N for every cardinal coordinate.
envelope.exact_gap: Q_N-lambda_N^statG=(T_N/(4d_N))sum_j j_(X_j)(t_j)+(gL_N/d_N)sum_j kappa_4(X_j)t_j^2 before translation-Haar averaging.
envelope.heterogeneity_reduction: The exact gap is an arithmetic mean of one scalar objective, so arbitrary coordinate heterogeneity cannot beat its scalar infimum; repeating one near-minimizer attains the same infimum.
envelope.widened_functional: h_g^scalar-card-up=h_g^prof+inf_(C,X,t){(tau_g(C)/4)j_X(t)+g ell_g(C)kappa_4(X)t^2} over fixed K1683 blocks and bounded centered symmetric unit-variance seeds.
envelope.scope_guard: The reduction binds independent coordinate channels on a fixed exchangeable rectangular cardinal block before Haar averaging; it does not cover correlated cumulant tensors, moving shapes or exact Haar Fisher savings.
